newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds stagnant, rates seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds stagnant, rates seen steady.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended a dull session marked by low volatility and volume, and dealers said they expected another cautious trading day tomorrow.
"The market lacked volatility all day. Upward potential is limited," said a fixed rate director.

"Portuguese bonds did not accompany the rise of Bonos or BTPs, and the cautious mood is here to stay. Unless Bunds release themselves from the grip of U.S. Treasuries, Portuguese bonds cannot claim support," he added.
